# BlindRoute
> Zero-Trust FHE API Middleware — compute on encrypted data without ever decrypting it.

## About
BlindRoute wraps any arithmetic API in Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) so the server computes on encrypted data without ever seeing plaintext. Dual-scheme: CKKS (real numbers, ML, statistics) + BFV (integers, finance). GPU-accelerated NTT via wgpu. Browser-native WASM demo. MIT licensed.

## Pages
- Home: https://blindroute.jesed.dev/ — Landing page with live interactive WASM FHE demo
- Math Docs: https://blindroute.jesed.dev/docs/ — Mathematical exposition of CKKS, BFV, NTT, RLWE

## Key Concepts
- Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE): Computation on ciphertexts without decryption
- CKKS: Approximate arithmetic on real/complex numbers via canonical embedding
- BFV: Exact integer arithmetic via polynomial encoding
- NTT: Number-Theoretic Transform — O(N log N) polynomial multiplication over finite fields
- RLWE: Ring Learning With Errors — quantum-resistant cryptographic foundation
- Circuit IR: Declarative arithmetic circuit definition with `circuit!` macro
- Gadget Relinearization: Noise-optimized 3→2 component ciphertext reduction

## Quick Start
```
curl -fsSL https://blindroute.jesed.dev/install.sh | sh
blindroute keygen --out keys/
blindroute encrypt --pub keys/pub.json --in data.json --out ct.json
blindroute compute add ct.json ct.json --out sum.json
blindroute decrypt --sec keys/sec.json --in sum.json
```
